verdict.rationale: Deel documents an API endpoint for creating contractor contracts (POST /rest/contracts) and an official MCP server that exposes contracts, people, and payroll operations to agents, with OAuth2 auth and a sandbox for safe testing. That gives an agent a programmatic way to start onboarding a worker. However, the evidence only shows contractor contract creation, list-contracts, and time-off tools, not end-to-end employee creation with compensation and tax setup. Missing for 10: documented employee/EOR hire creation endpoint or MCP tool, compensation setup via API, tax/withholding setup via API, and hands-on corroboration of an agent completing an onboarding flow.
